name: Epsilon prediction
tagline: DDPM-original target: model regresses the added noise epsilon; x0 recovered analytically from x_t.
diff_from_baseline: Ho, Jain & Abbeel 2020 (DDPM, NeurIPS). Standard noise-prediction parameterization used by the vast majority of pixel-space DDPMs and the original CIFAR-10 baselines.

name: V-prediction
tagline: Velocity target $v=\sqrt{\bar\alpha}\epsilon-\sqrt{1-\bar\alpha}x_0$; x0 recovered by an inverse rotation.
diff_from_baseline: Salimans & Ho 2022 (Progressive Distillation, ICLR). Velocity parameterization that smoothly interpolates between epsilon and x0 prediction; widely used in Stable Diffusion v2 and modern DDIM samplers.

name: x0 prediction
tagline: Direct clean-image target: model outputs x0 itself, no inverse conversion needed for DDIM sampling.
diff_from_baseline: Sohl-Dickstein et al. 2015; revisited by Ho et al. 2020. Direct mean-prediction baseline; simple and DDIM-compatible but yields unstable gradients at high noise where signal $\sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\to0$.
